bar.name: First Refrain
bar.text: Your first cooldown spell each battle is sure to echo.

bar.name: Resonant Kill
bar.text: When you kill an enemy, your longest cooldown drops by 1.

bar.name: Low Tide
bar.text: Once per battle, when your MP drops below 25%, your next spell costs no MP.

bar.name: Momentum
bar.text: When you kill an enemy, your next spell +15% damage.

bar.name: Encore
bar.text: Once per battle, when you drop below 40% HP, all your cooldowns are reset.

0.f2.name: Killing Echo
0.f2.text: Spell Echo +3% chance per rank when the spell kills.

0.f3.name: Rapid Recall
0.f3.text: After Spell Echo triggers, your next turn comes 4% sooner per rank.

0.n0.name: Overload
0.n0.text: The spell you recast after a Spell Echo is a sure critical.

0.r.name: Overtone
0.r.text: Spell Echo +1% chance per rank for each enemy the spell hits beyond the first.

0.ea.name: Echo Chamber
0.ea.text: Each echo in a battle adds +3% to your Spell Echo chance for the rest of that battle.

0.eb.name: Sympathy
0.eb.text: When Spell Echo triggers, your other cooldown spells drop by 1.

0.ma.name: Endless Refrain
0.ma.text: A spell recast after an echo has double Spell Echo chance.

0.fa.name: Unstable Weave
0.fa.text: Recast spells deal +40% damage, but a cooldown spell that fails to echo gets +1 turn of cooldown.

0.fb.name: Frayed Threads
0.fb.text: Sympathy cuts 2 turns instead of 1, but Spell Echo chance drops 25% → 18%.

0.mb.name: Time Fold
0.mb.text: When Spell Echo triggers, that spell's recast costs only half a turn.

0.v.name: Arcane Overload
0.v.text: Spell Echo evolves: an echo resets all your cooldowns, not just the spell's, and the recast deals +20% damage.

1.f1.name: Focused Bolt
1.f1.text: Fire Bolt +2% critical chance per rank.

1.f2.name: Searing Crit
1.f2.text: Fire Bolt critical damage +6% per rank.

1.f3.name: Clean Shot
1.f3.text: Fire Bolt +6% damage per rank against targets at full HP.

1.n0.name: Weak Spot
1.n0.text: Fire Bolt critical hits ignore 30% of Magic Armor.

1.r.name: Finisher
1.r.text: Fire Bolt +5% damage per rank against targets below 30% HP.

1.ea.name: Keen Gaze
1.ea.text: Fire Bolt cannot miss and gains +10% critical chance.

1.eb.name: Execution Bolt
1.eb.text: Fire Bolt deals +50% damage to targets below 25% HP.

1.ma.name: Hot Streak
1.ma.text: A critical Fire Bolt makes your next Fire Bolt a sure critical.

1.fa.name: Unstable Focus
1.fa.text: Fire Bolt critical hits deal +50% more, but its non-critical hits deal 20% less.

1.fb.name: Reckless Bolt
1.fb.text: Fire Bolt +35% damage against targets below 50% HP, but 20% less against healthier ones.

1.mb.name: Rolling Doom
1.mb.text: If Fire Bolt kills, it fires again at once at the lowest-HP enemy for free, and repeats for every kill.

1.v.name: Sunfire
1.v.text: Fire Bolt evolves into Sunfire: it deals +40% damage, and a critical Sunfire splashes its full damage to the enemies beside the target.

2.f1.name: Biting Gale
2.f1.text: Blizzard has a 10% chance per rank to Slow each enemy hit for 1 turn.

2.f2.name: Numbing Cold
2.f2.text: Blizzard +4% damage per rank against Slowed enemies.

2.f3.name: Driving Snow
2.f3.text: Blizzard has a 5% chance per rank to Blind each enemy hit for 1 turn.

2.n0.name: Hard Frost
2.n0.text: Blizzard always Slows the enemies in the front row of its area for 1 turn.

2.r.name: Snow Blindness
2.r.text: Blizzard +4% damage per rank against Blinded enemies.

2.ea.name: Flash Freeze
2.ea.text: Each enemy already Slowed when Blizzard hits has a 50% chance to be Stunned for 1 turn.

2.eb.name: Whiteout
2.eb.text: Blizzard's chance to Blind is doubled, and its Blind lasts 2 turns.

2.ma.name: Winter's Grip
2.ma.text: While any enemy is Stunned, Blizzard's cooldown is 1 instead of 2.

2.fa.name: Black Ice
2.fa.text: Flash Freeze always Stuns, but Blizzard deals 40% less damage.

2.fb.name: Howling Squall
2.fb.text: Blizzard covers 3 rows x 3 lanes instead of 3 x 2, but it costs 14 → 20 MP.

2.mb.name: Lost in the Snow
2.mb.text: An enemy Blinded by Blizzard that misses an attack is Stunned for 1 turn.

2.v.name: Eternal Winter
2.v.text: Blizzard evolves: the storm stays on its area for 2 turns and Slows every enemy that starts its turn there.

3.f1.name: Rimeguard
3.f1.text: Mana Barrier shield +5% per rank when cast on an ally in the front row.

3.f2.name: Cauterize
3.f2.text: Each debuff Mana Barrier dispels heals the ally for 2% of max HP per rank.

3.f3.name: Numbing Touch
3.f3.text: While Mana Barrier holds, Slowed attackers deal 3% less damage per rank to the holder.

3.n0.name: Ice Mirror
3.n0.text: The first hit Mana Barrier absorbs Slows the attacker for 2 turns.

3.r.name: Frozen Reserve
3.r.text: Mana Barrier gives +1 MP per rank for each hit it absorbs from a Slowed enemy.

3.ea.name: Frost Armor
3.ea.text: Every hit Mana Barrier absorbs Slows the attacker for 1 turn.

3.eb.name: Ice Block
3.eb.text: Mana Barrier also makes the holder Fortified for 1 turn.

3.ma.name: Frozen Rebuke
3.ma.text: A Slowed enemy that hits Mana Barrier is Stunned for 1 turn (once per barrier).

3.fa.name: Brittle Shell
3.fa.text: Frost Armor Slows for 2 turns, but Mana Barrier's shield is 35% smaller.

3.fb.name: Frozen Solid
3.fb.text: Ice Block lasts 2 turns, but the holder is Slowed while it lasts.

3.mb.name: Twin Ward
3.mb.text: Mana Barrier also shields the ally with the lowest HP for 50% of its value.

3.v.name: Shatter Aegis
3.v.text: Mana Barrier evolves: when it breaks, it fires a free Fire Bolt at the attacker that is a sure critical.

4.u3.name: Sea of Fire
4.u3.text: Meteor's Burning ground also covers every cell touching the plus shape.

4.r1.name: Concussion
4.r1.text: Meteor Stuns the enemy at its center for 1 turn.

4.r2.name: Ringing Ears
4.r2.text: Enemies on Meteor's outer cells have a 25% chance to be Stunned for 1 turn.

4.r3.name: Earthshaker
4.r3.text: Each enemy Meteor hits has a 50% chance to be Staggered: it loses its next action.

4.d1.name: Flung Embers
4.d1.text: Meteor flings an ember at a random enemy outside its area: 30% INT and Burning for 2 turns.

4.d3.name: Twin Meteors
4.d3.text: One turn after Meteor lands, a second meteor strikes the same cells for 50% power.

4.l1.name: Dead Center
4.l1.text: Meteor deals +40% damage to the enemy at its center.

4.l2.name: Molten Core
4.l2.text: Meteor's Burning ground deals double damage on its center cell.

4.l3.name: Extinction
4.l3.text: Meteor's center target takes +20% damage for each other enemy the Meteor hits.
